evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 平湖秋月、福海
evidence.excerpt_zh: 平湖秋月在福海西北隅正宇三楹西為流水音東北出山口臨河為花嶼蘭皋折而東南度橋為兩峯挿雲又東南為山水樂其北為君子軒為藏密樓（圓明園册）臣等謹按平湖秋月四十景之一額為世宗御書流水音花嶼蘭皋諸額為皇上御書
evidence.summary: In the north-west corner of 福海: 平湖秋月, three bays, with 流水音, 花嶼蘭皋, 兩峯挿雲, 山水樂, 君子軒 and 藏密樓.

evidence.title: 平湖秋月: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
evidence.date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.263 item (1), under 平湖秋月
evidence.excerpt_zh: 平湖日午泛轻航，飒飒南风喜送凉。鸣籁青松遮碧嶂，含芳紫槿映虚堂。倏看雨脚疎还密，乍听雷声隐复扬。四望溟蒙涵妙景，瀛洲图书水中央。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 平湖秋月, 1823, on rain and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 平湖秋月: 道光四年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
evidence.date: 道光四年 (1824), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.263 item (2), under 平湖秋月
evidence.excerpt_zh: 已欣春雪遍沾濡，何幸甘霖润似酥。近户点波声淅沥，隔溪羃树影模糊。新正嘉泽真难遇，开岁鸿慈沐更殊。预庆来牟兆丰稔，虚窗对处寸心愉。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 平湖秋月, 1824, on rain and the harvest. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 平湖秋月: 咸丰七年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
evidence.date: 咸丰七年 (1857), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.263 item (7), under 平湖秋月
evidence.excerpt_zh:
鹜望平湖雨似麻，丝丝作势趁
风斜。一痕湿霭横林幄，无限凉飔透户纱。饼饵添香田畔麦，臙脂挹润槛前花。屡膺吴眷弥增惕，从此旬沾徧迩遐。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Xianfeng Emperor at 平湖秋月, 1857, on rain and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 平湖秋月
evidence.locator: from p.263, under 平湖秋月
evidence.summary: 平湖秋月: 8 dated items, 1744-1857, of which 7 poems and 1 court records (Qianlong, Daoguang, Xianfeng); recurring themes: the view, rain, the harvest. First dated 1744, last dated 1857.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
